notes.title: Game Update(V.0.7.1.12.9)
notes.content:
Hey Everyone.The server has been restart.
Update List;
1.In the room, when the line is encountered in the hand of the card will appear a soldier of the information panel, to facilitate the players to understand the information and do not have to take a card like before。
2.The hint of a spell is more obvious in the tutorial (an arrow on the back of the hand).
3.About Special attack(The Card behind your tower).Added a special effect, so it looks more obvious
4.Modified on the matching process, and now can be free to challenge the players, and do not need to match the two players at the same time
5.Fix the Bug of STAGE 1...........again......(I very very very very hate this bug.If anyone happen again,Please let me know)
6.Online personnel management
7.Fix some English tips
Hope enjoy it and have a good weekend.
